text: こういうものには　つかいどきが　あるのじゃ！

structure.jp: つかいどきが　あるのじゃ！
structure.en: there is a right time to use them!

patterns.name: 〜のだ
patterns.explanation: のだ at the end of a sentence gives it an explaining, 'you see' tone. じゃ here is the old-man way of saying だ. あるのじゃ = 'there is one, you see'.

patterns.name: 〜には
patterns.explanation: には sets up what the statement applies to: 'when it comes to this'. こういうものには = 'for things like this'.
